evaluation_procedure_001.evidence: ARTICLE II - RIGHTS AND RESPONSIBILITIES Section G - Employee Evaluation

evaluation_system_002.answer: Classroom Teacher Evaluation System (CTES); Marzano Evaluation Model
evaluation_system_002.evidence: The Parties agree that the primary purpose of the Classroom Teacher Evaluation System (CTES) is to provide employees with a framework to improve instruction... The Parties have agreed to use the Marzano Evaluation Model.

evaluation_observation_count_003.evidence: Each employee will be observed during the school year by his/her observer the number of times set forth in the CTES Handbook.

evaluation_observation_duration_004.answer: Walk-throughs: 3-8 minutes; Informals: 9-20 minutes; Formals: 30-55 minutes (or until lesson completion)
evaluation_observation_duration_004.evidence: Walk-through observations are 3-8 minutes in length. Informal observations are 9-20 minutes in length Formal observations are 30-55 minutes in length or may last until the completion of a lesson.

evaluation_ratings_005.answer: Highly Effective, Effective, Needs Improvement/Developing, and Unsatisfactory
evaluation_ratings_005.evidence: Develop differentiation among state levels of performance: Highly Effective, Effective, Needs Improvement (Developing for employees in first three years of employment) and Unsatisfactory.

evaluation_student_growth_006.evidence: All employees' evaluations will use student learning growth scores approved by the State.
